contentText:
There was a dayslong Outlook outage . A nationwide ground stop for only the second time in 25 years. Banks seemed to suddenly stop working . Even iCloud couldn't stay up and running . This week, it felt like the technological world simply collapsed. And it felt like this might be the beginning of something even bigger.

On this episode of The Vergecast , Nilay and David go through the week's many calamities, and try to explain both what happened in each case - which was generally much milder than the conspiracy theories would have you believe - and why all these small issues might still add up to something worth worrying about.
